runtime.scope: Runtime stdio readiness checks; not a penetration test or formal certification.

checks.name: Process startup and stdio binding
checks.details: Process spawned without a shell and remained alive through the startup grace period.

checks.name: Tool discovery and schema structure
checks.details: Discovered 1 tool(s) with structurally valid input schemas.

checks.name: High-impact tool metadata review
checks.details: No high-impact capability keywords were identified in tool metadata.

checks.name: Unknown tool rejection
checks.details: Server returned a JSON-RPC error for an unknown tool.

checks.name: Concurrent request correlation
checks.details: Resolved 5 concurrent requests without timeout or identifier mismatch.

checks.name: Stdout protocol purity
checks.details: Observed 1 non-JSON stdout line(s); stdout logging can corrupt stdio transport.

checks.name: Runtime secret exposure scan
checks.details: No supported credential patterns were detected in captured stdout or stderr.

checks.name: Evidence capture bounds
checks.details: Captured output stayed within configured byte limits.
